title: Local obituary: Kyle Kennedy, 42, Westwood mother devoted to early childhood education
author: Boston.com Staff
bullets: Kyle Francis Kennedy, 42, passed away peacefully on September 21, 2026, at her home in Westwood, Massachusetts.
Born in Washington, DC, she spent most of her life in Massachusetts, where she built a career devoted to early childhood education.

Blessed with a formidable intellect, dry wit, and beauty, she will be remembered for her devotion to her children, Conor, Josephine, and Declan, and her support for educational reform for disadvantaged children and for people living with disabilities.
